stories.title: Stevens County Sheriff's Office searching for suspect who shot at law enforcement
stories.summary: Officials are searching for a suspect who is armed with a rifle. SCSO asks everyone to shelter in place and to call 911 if they see the suspect.

stories.title: The first snowfall of the season is here!
stories.summary: KREM 2's Snow Tracker is on the road covering the first snowfall of the season.

stories.title: ICE 'out of control' in dramatic SEA arrest caught on camera, governor says
stories.summary: Dramatic video showed masked ICE agents detaining two passengers on a jet bridge at SEA Airport Saturday morning.

stories.title: Sandpoint residents to receive free parking permits next year
stories.summary: The Sandpoint City Council voted unanimously to approve the parking permit changes at its Nov. 18 meeting.

stories.title: Rathdrum development offers ownership opportunities for individuals making 80% of area median income
stories.summary: The Hayden Homes Solara community is slated to be complete and ready for move-in by fall 2027, a press release said.

stories.title: Two killed in Friday night crash along US 395 near Deer Park
stories.summary: Washington State Patrol says the accident occurred around 7:30 p.m. at milepost 179.

stories.title: 49 Degrees North looking to expand ski area by 1,200 acres
stories.summary: The proposed project would add 26 new trails and amenities, including terrain for more advanced riders.

stories.title: Spokane County leaders share plans to tackle winter weather
stories.summary: The county is gearing up this winter with more than 70 employees working across four districts.

stories.title: Driver rescued after semi-truck flips over into Coeur d’Alene River
stories.summary: Idaho State Police confirmed to KREM 2 News that the accident occurred at 9 p.m. near mile marker 43 of Coeur d’Alene River Road.

stories.title: Sacajawea Middle School warns that students ‘may have’ been exposed to whooping cough
stories.summary: “Spokane Regional Health District has seen an increased number of whooping cough cases,” the school said in a Friday announcement.

stories.title: Spokane Valley Fire Department will ask voters to approve replacement levy in February
stories.summary: The proposed four-year replacement levy would fund day-to-day operations and critical capital needs for the 2028–2031 period.

stories.title: Idaho Potato Drop officially being hosted in Caldwell; exact location pending
stories.summary: As for the exact location, Phillips said it is between Indian Creek Plaza in the city's downtown and the "Caldwell Event Center area."
